answer_1.quote: We introduce Exemplar-Based Expository Text Generation, a novel task that generates an expository text on a new topic by leveraging an exemplar from a similar topic...
answer_1.outputs: expository texts on a target topic that imitate the structure and content of a source text while adapting to the new topic

answer_2.quote: To provide a basic assessment of this generation task, we use well-established metrics commonly used in previous research, namely ROUGE, BLEU, and METEOR.

answer_3.quote: We leverage LLM-as-a-Judge to evaluate Imitativeness and Adaptiveness.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three expert annotators, all graduate students with specialized knowledge in NLP, to evaluate model outputs using the same instructions given to the LLMs...
answer_4.guideline: evaluate model outputs based on Imitativeness and Adaptiveness using the same instructions given to the LLMs
